entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: A vampiric hierophant of the Legion of Dusk who staggers into Fort Adanto lost to the Blood Fast, devoted to Saint Elenda and sworn to continue his mission.

entities.name: Mardia
entities.description: The vampiric priest of Fort Adanto who subdues Mavren Fein and offers him the means to continue his mission.

entities.name: Manuel
entities.description: A human prisoner at Fort Adanto, jailed for killing a compatriot over cards, who is given to Mavren Fein to break his fast.

entities.name: Saint Elenda
entities.description: A warrior nun who guarded the Immortal Sun, became the first vampire, searched for the sun for centuries and sailed back west; revered by the Legion of Dusk.

entities.name: Pedron the Wicked
entities.description: The betrayer who, in Mavren Fein's telling, killed the nuns who guarded the Immortal Sun in Torrezon.

entities.name: Vona of Iedo
entities.description: A centuries-old vampire warrior of the Legion of Dusk who captains the first ship out in search of Saint Elenda and secretly relishes her bloodlust.

entities.name: Queen Miralda
entities.description: The queen who assembled a fleet to voyage in search of Saint Elenda.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker without his memories who sails with the Belligerent's crew and learns from Vraska that he is a planeswalker.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker who captains the Belligerent and seeks Orazca with the thaumatic compass.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin knife-wielder of the Belligerent's crew who stays on the beach to fight the vampires.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A member of the Belligerent's crew whom Jace remembers.

entities.name: Gavven
entities.description: A member of the Belligerent's crew whom Jace remembers.

entities.name: Amelia
entities.description: A member of the Belligerent's crew whom Jace remembers.

entities.name: Edgar
entities.description: A member of the Belligerent's crew who is lost in the crash and battle.

entities.name: Huatli
aliases: future warrior poet of the Sun Empire
entities.description: A Sun Empire warrior and clawfoot rider who seeks a River Herald guide to Orazca.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: A Sun Empire rider on a bladetooth who serves as Huatli's second-in-command.

entities.name: Teyeuh
entities.description: A Sun Empire rider on a frillhorn in Huatli's company.

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: An old River Herald merfolk and illusionist who summoned the storm and agrees to guide Huatli to Orazca.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: A River Herald who has betrayed Tishana's cause and is traveling to Orazca, meaning to unbalance radical dependencies.

entities.name: Fort Adanto
entities.description: A walled Legion of Dusk garrison fort on the coast with a church and holding cells.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire army and church of Torrezon whose ships search for Saint Elenda and the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: The pirate alliance whose ship, the Belligerent, carries the compass-bearing captain.

entities.name: The Belligerent
entities.description: A Brazen Coalition ship captained by Vraska, wrecked on the shore of Ixalan.

entities.name: Her Majesty's Courage
entities.description: Mavren Fein's Legion of Dusk ship, lost when its navigational tools were destroyed.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: A relic once guarded by Saint Elenda's order that the Legion of Dusk seeks on Ixalan.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The Golden City that the compass points to, thought to hold the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where the expeditions land and race to find Orazca.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane that Vraska says is not this one.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The continent of the Church and Crown, where Saint Elenda's order guarded the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: The merfolk of Ixalan, famous for elemental magic and obtuse speech.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The dinosaur-riding empire of Ixalan to which Huatli belongs.

entities.name: Blood Fast
entities.description: A vampiric fast of abstaining from blood that drives the faster mad with hunger.

entities.name: Apostasine Wars
entities.description: Wars in which the unified Church and Crown conquered kingdom after kingdom on Torrezon.

entities.name: Useless Island
entities.description: The island where Jace first woke.

entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: An outpost where Vraska and Jace docked and where a River Herald overheard talk of the compass.

entities.name: Thaumatic Compass
entities.description: A compass that points to Orazca and to blooms of powerful magic, including planeswalkers.

entities.name: Planeswalking
entities.description: The ability to travel between planes, which something on Ixalan yanks Jace and Vraska back from.

events.summary: A starving, crazed Mavren Fein stumbles up to Fort Adanto, proclaiming his faith in Saint Elenda.
events.quote: I have conquered the waves and death itself, praise Saint Elenda!

events.summary: Mavren Fein throws down his ruined navigational tools, claiming faith alone brought him to land.
events.quote: a crushed sextant, a broken compass, and a menagerie of other ruined navigational tools

events.summary: Mardia recognizes Mavren Fein and has the guards open the gate to let him in.
events.quote: Hierophant Mavren Fein?

events.summary: Smelling blood, Mavren Fein scales the fort wall and attacks a guard but cannot pierce his armor; the guards kick him off and Mardia pins him.
events.quote: He began to claw his way up the sides of Fort Adanto

events.summary: Mardia has Mavren Fein led to the holding cells and tells him prisoner Manuel will break his fast at dusk.
events.quote: Manuel killed a compatriot in a fight over a game of cards

events.summary: Mavren Fein tells Manuel the legend of Saint Elenda, the nun who guarded the Immortal Sun and became the first vampire.
events.quote: She was born mortal, a warrior nun charged with her brothers and sisters of faith to guard the Immortal Sun in the mountains of Torrezon.

events.summary: In the telling, Pedron the Wicked kills the guardians of the Immortal Sun and a winged beast steals the Sun from him.
events.quote: Pedron the Wicked killed them all.

events.summary: Mavren Fein breaks through the cell wall and feeds on Manuel, ending his Blood Fast.
events.quote: A breath later, his teeth were at the neck of the criminal, and the coppery scent of blood filled the air.

events.summary: Clear-minded again, Mavren Fein reveals his crew is dead and says he will continue the mission regardless.
events.quote: But I intend to continue our mission all the same.

events.summary: Vona's backstory: she relished the Apostasine Wars and her second birth as a vampire, and secretly still loves bloodshed.
events.quote: the day of her second birth, spent kneeling in a church, working the spell that would bind her life to serve the crown and church in perpetuity

events.summary: Bored in peacetime, Vona killed all her human serfs in a week-long game and abandoned her estate (flashback).
events.quote: over the course of one happy week killed each of them as part of a pleasant game

events.summary: Vona volunteers to lead the first ship in Queen Miralda's fleet searching for Saint Elenda.
events.quote: Vona had volunteered to lead the first ship that left port.

events.summary: Vona's ship closes on the Belligerent, hoping to board and feed on its crew.
events.quote: Boarding the pirate ship was ironic, but necessary to keep her sated.

events.summary: A conjured storm tosses Vona's ship, which rams into a sea stack and wrecks on the shore.
events.quote: just as her ship rammed into the side of the sea stack

events.summary: Vona kills and drinks from an injured pirate, declaring him guilty of deceit.
events.quote: I find you guilty of deceit, and a criminal in the eyes of the Church.

events.summary: Vona marches into the jungle alone, intent on taking the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: She was the Butcher of Magan, and the Immortal Sun was hers for the taking.

events.summary: Jace and Vraska, who leapt overboard in the storm, swim ashore.
events.quote: he had leapt overboard alongside Vraska.

events.summary: Jace puts a charging vampire to sleep with his mind magic.
events.quote: The vampire in front of him stumbled in the sand and collapsed to the ground, snoring.

events.summary: Vraska petrifies another vampire with her gaze, warning Jace to close his eyes.
events.quote: A petrified vampire lay at his feet.

events.summary: Vraska reports that the crew has lost Edgar.
events.quote: We lost Edgar

events.summary: Breeches volunteers the crew to fight the Legion of Dusk while Vraska and Jace seek the Sun, to be tracked by Jace's illusion.
events.quote: We fight Dusk, you find Sun! Meet up later!

events.summary: Vraska orders the crew to leave the locals alone but kill every vampire.
events.quote: kill every vampire you find.

events.summary: Jace veils himself and Vraska in invisibility and hides their footprints as they flee upriver in the dinghy.
events.quote: He shut his eyes and dutifully willed a veil of invisibility over himself and Vraska.

events.summary: Vraska reveals to Jace that neither is from Ixalan and that she is a planeswalker, planeswalking in front of him.
events.quote: We're Planeswalkers.

events.summary: Vraska theorizes that Orazca holds the enchantment that stops them from leaving the plane.
events.quote: I believe that Orazca doesn't just contain the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Jace works out that the compass points to blooms of powerful magic and aetheric north, which is why it pointed to him.
events.quote: We thought the compass was just pointing to the city, but it points to blooms of powerful magic.

events.summary: Vraska apologizes for hiding her planeswalking and thanks Jace for listening to her story.
events.quote: No one has ever listened to my story like you did. Thank you.

events.summary: Jace senses people nearby, including a minotaur.
events.quote: One human, one vampire, a merfolk . . . and a minotaur.

events.summary: Huatli and her riders search the beach for a River Herald who could guide her to the Golden City.
events.quote: This is where she would find her guide to lead her to the Golden City.

events.summary: Huatli glimpses Vraska among the wrecked ships.
events.quote: Her skin was emerald green, more reptilian than anything else

events.summary: Huatli finds the unconscious Tishana on a rock and wakes her.
events.quote: There, lying on the rock overlooking the vast, unending ocean, was an unconscious female merfolk.

events.summary: Tishana tells Huatli that a River Herald, Kumena, has betrayed her cause and is heading to Orazca.
events.quote: A River Herald has betrayed my cause and is traveling there now.

events.summary: Huatli kneels and swears she means no claim on Orazca, and Tishana agrees to guide her, warning she will kill her if she tries to claim it.
events.quote: We are not each other's enemy.

events.summary: Tishana senses that Huatli really did see the city and gives her the terms of the alliance.
events.quote: If you say you saw a city when you skimmed the edges of our world, then I believe you.

events.summary: Tishana animates a jade totem into an elemental mount.
events.quote: began to form the shape of an elemental

events.summary: Huatli sends Inti and Teyeuh after a fleeing vampire.
events.quote: Inti, tail them!

events.summary: Tishana spots an illusion on the river water, which she judges beyond the vampires' mastery.
events.quote: Someone is casting an illusion there, on the water.

events.summary: Tishana and Huatli resolve to take the compass from the illusionist's boat, and Tishana admits even the River Heralds do not know where Orazca is.
events.quote: We need their compass more than we need them dead

relations.note: They flee upriver together and Vraska confides in him.
relations.quote: No one has ever listened to my story like you did. Thank you.

relations.note: Vraska is the captain of the Belligerent's crew.
relations.quote: the rest of the crew behind him listened attentively to their captain.

relations.note: Vona's purpose was delivered by the queen.
relations.quote: Her purpose was one touched by divinity and delivered by the queen herself.

relations.note: He sailed on a Legion of Dusk ship.
relations.quote: The finest ship in the Legion of Dusk!

relations.note: She is the priest of the fort.
relations.quote: The priest of Fort Adanto had made her way to the door.
Inti looked down at his captain
A River Herald has betrayed my cause and is traveling there now.

relations.note: Tishana agrees to guide Huatli to Orazca.
relations.quote: If you say you saw a city when you skimmed the edges of our world, then I believe you.
the crew of The Belligerent drew their weapons and charged the remaining vampires.
